# FileOmniTool

> 100% Free & Private In-Browser File Tools powered by WebAssembly and HTML5 Canvas. Zero Server Uploads.

FileOmniTool (https://www.fileomnitool.com) is an open web utility platform providing 75 client-side tools for converting, compressing, editing, and analyzing files directly inside the user's browser memory. Unlike traditional cloud converters, no files or personal data are ever uploaded to remote servers.

## Core Value & Privacy Guarantee
- **100% Client-Side**: All file processing happens locally in RAM using WebAssembly (Wasm) and native web APIs.
- **Zero Server Uploads**: Confidential documents, personal photos, and sensitive data never leave the user's device.
- **No Signup & Free**: Unlimited usage, no paywalls, zero accounts required.
- **Multilingual Support**: Available in English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, and Portuguese.

## Tool Categories & Tools Index

### PDF & Document Suite
- [Merge PDF](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/pdf-merge): Combine multiple PDF documents into one without cloud uploads.
- [Split PDF](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/pdf-split): Extract specific pages or split PDF into single-page documents.
- [Rotate PDF](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/pdf-rotate): Permanently rotate PDF pages by 90°, 180°, or 270°.
- [PDF to Text](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/pdf-to-text): Extract raw text content directly from PDF pages in-browser.
- [Page Number PDF](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/pdf-page-number): Add professional header/footer page numbers to PDF documents.
- [Grayscale PDF](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/pdf-grayscale): Convert color PDFs to black & white / grayscale for economical printing.
- [PDF Metadata Editor](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/pdf-metadata): Inspect and edit title, author, subject, and keywords in PDF files.
- [Organize PDF Pages](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/pdf-organize): Reorder, remove, or rearrange PDF pages.
- [Encrypt & Password Protect PDF](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/pdf-encrypt): Secure PDF documents with RC4/AES passwords locally.
- [Flatten PDF Forms](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/pdf-flatten): Burn interactive form fields and annotations permanently into the PDF.

### Image Tools
- [Image Converter](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/image-convert): Convert WebP, PNG, JPG, and AVIF in-browser.
- [Image Compressor](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/image-compress): Compress images to targeted file size or quality without quality loss.
- [SVG to PNG Converter](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/svg-to-png): Render vector SVG graphics into crisp raster PNGs at custom scale.
- [Remove EXIF Metadata](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/exif-remover): Strip GPS coordinates, camera model, and timestamp from JPG/PNG images.
- [Resize Image](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/image-resize): Resize dimensions while preserving aspect ratio.
- [Watermark Image](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/image-watermark): Overlay custom text or logo watermarks on photos.
- [Crop Image](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/image-crop): Interactive bounding box cropping in HTML5 Canvas.
- [Image Blur](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/image-blur): Apply box or Gaussian blur to redact sensitive image areas.
- [Invert Colors](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/image-invert): Invert image pixel colors client-side.
- [Flip & Mirror Image](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/image-flip): Flip photos horizontally or vertically.
- [Grayscale Image](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/image-grayscale): Convert photos to monochrome grayscale.
- [Image to Base64](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/image-to-base64): Encode images to Data URI / Base64 text.
- [Base64 to Image](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/base64-to-image): Decode Base64 strings back to downloadable PNG/JPG images.
- [Favicon Generator](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/favicon-generator): Generate multi-size favicon sets (16x16, 32x32, 48x48).
- [PNG to ICO Converter](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/png-to-ico): Generate binary Windows .ico icons from PNG.
- [SVG Cleaner & Minifier](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/svg-cleaner): Sanitize SVG files, strip malicious scripts and unused attributes.
- [Image to ASCII Art](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/image-to-ascii): Turn any picture into retro ASCII text characters.
- [GIF Frame Extractor](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/gif-frame-extractor): Extract individual frames from animated GIFs as ZIP.

### Audio & Video Utilities
- [Audio Converter](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/audio-convert): Convert WAV, MP3, and OGG client-side.
- [Audio Trimmer & Cutter](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/audio-trim): Trim sound files with precision millisecond sliders.
- [Video to Audio Extractor](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/video-to-audio): Extract sound tracks from MP4, WebM, and MKV video files.
- [Volume Booster](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/audio-booster): Amplify quiet audio files via Web Audio API.
- [Audio Playback Speed](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/audio-speed): Speed up or slow down audio recordings from 0.25x to 4x.
- [Audio Reverse](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/audio-reverse): Reverse audio waveforms for creative sound design.
- [Stereo to Mono Downmixer](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/audio-stereo-to-mono): Downmix dual channel audio to single channel mono.
- [Audio Tone Generator](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/audio-tone): Generate sine, square, sawtooth, and triangle audio frequencies.

### Archives & Compression
- [Create ZIP Archive](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/zip-create): Package multiple files into compressed ZIP folders client-side.
- [Extract ZIP Archive](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/zip-extract): Unpack ZIP archives directly in browser memory.

### Developer, Text & Data Tools
- [JSON to CSV Converter](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/json-csv): Convert nested JSON objects to CSV tables.
- [JSON to SQL Converter](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/json-to-sql): Transform JSON arrays into SQL INSERT statements.
- [HTML to Markdown](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/html-to-markdown): Convert rich HTML pages or snippets into clean Markdown.
- [JWT Decoder](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/jwt-decoder): Inspect JWT header and payload claims securely without leaking secrets.
- [CSS Minifier](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/css-minifier): Minify stylesheet code and strip comments for optimal page load.
- [Epoch Unix Timestamp Converter](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/epoch-converter): Convert Unix timestamps to human ISO 8601 dates and vice-versa.
- [File to Base64](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/file-to-base64): Encode any file into a Base64 string locally.
- [File Magic Byte Detector](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/file-magic-detector): Detect true file types by inspecting binary header magic signatures.
- [SRT to VTT Subtitles](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/srt-to-vtt): Convert SubRip .srt subtitles to WebVTT .vtt for HTML5 video.
- [SRT to Plain Text](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/srt-to-txt): Strip timecodes from subtitles to extract pure dialogue text.
- [Hash Generator](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/hash-generator): Compute SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1, and MD5 hashes using Web Crypto API.
- [File Checksum](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/file-checksum): Verify file integrity against expected cryptographic checksums.
- [Hex Viewer](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/hex-viewer): Inspect binary bytes with hexadecimal and ASCII representation.
- [QR Code Generator](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/qr-generator): Create custom high-resolution QR codes in-browser.
- [Regex Tester](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/regex-tester): Test JavaScript regular expressions with real-time match highlighting.
- [Markdown to HTML Preview](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/markdown-preview): Live markdown editor and HTML renderer.
- [Password Generator](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/password-generator): Cryptographically secure random passwords (Web Crypto CSPRNG).
- [UUID v4 Generator](https://www.fileomnitool.com/tools/uuid-generator): Generate RFC 4122 compliant unique identifiers.
